description: Piotr Lechowicz, Carlos Natalino and Paolo Monti publish two lightpath datasets for quality-of-transmission estimation in elastic optical networks. The March 2025 Zenodo record supplies nobel-eu and janos-us SSV files under CC BY 4.0. Although its description is empty, the authors’ describing paper explicitly cites this DOI and documents simulated lightpath features with analytical generalised signal-to-noise ratios. It uses the European and United States SNDlib topologies, accepting 188,557 and 172,319 of 200,000 generated requests respectively. These examples can train or compare signal-quality estimators within routing and spectrum-allocation simulations. They are synthetic network-operation cases, not field measurements; transferability to other equipment and loads remains uncertain. Related catalogue record data-sndlib covers the underlying topology collection, not these derived signal-quality samples. The article was read through the browser; no PDF or data files were saved to the workspace.
